thread:
Mia: Hey — multiple customers reporting dashboard frames return 'No data' and panels spinning. Console logs show 500s from /api/analytics/query (analytics.prod). Example x-request-id: abcd-1234. Any known incidents?

Raj: We're seeing an alert spike since ~13:55 UTC — 500 errors and timeouts when aggregator talks to ClickHouse. Error snippets show `prefetch timeout` and `upstream read error`. Can you paste a sample req id and reproduction steps?

Mia: Sample req: abcd-1234, customer: acme-inc, dashboard_id: dg-72. Repro steps: open Dashboard > wait for panels to load > frontend issues a POST to /api/analytics/query which returns 500 with body `internal server error`. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/issue-1778882345/screen.png

Tess: Pulling logs now. Quick mitigation: disabling panel prefetch seems to reduce noise (feature flag `dashboard.panel_prefetch=false`). Also looks like the analytics-aggregator circuit-breaker tripped due to a surge after the last deploy. Do you want me to restart the aggregator pods?

Mia: Yes please. Also customers report missing metrics for ~2 hours — could retention/ingest be related?

Raj: Not retention. Timestamps align with a deploy at 13:55 UTC (aggregator v2). Staging rollback to v1 restored normal responses in a smoke test. I'm going to canary rollback in prod. For triage, capture logs with:

```
kubectl logs -l app=analytics-aggregator -n prod --since=30m | grep "ERROR" -A3 | sed -n '1,200p'
```
and trace requests by request-id header (`x-request-id: abcd-1234`). Also check ClickHouse query queue depth: `clickhouse client --query "SELECT * FROM system.metric"` for spikes.

Tess: Restart started (rolling restart analytics-aggregator). Watching metrics: error rate went from ~18% -> ~2% over the last 3 minutes. If it keeps falling I'll hold off on rollback.

Mia: Thanks — I'll update affected customers and ask support ops to collect repros. Quick repro curl (for engineers):

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-request-id: abcd-1234" \
  -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/query" \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval 1 hour","format":"json"}'
```
Mia: Marking P1 for now. @support-bot please create incident and notify eng:analytics. :raised_hands:

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0423 and assigned to eng:analytics. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0423

Mia: Closing loop here — restart + temporary feature-flag toggle brought errors down. Raj will follow up with postmortem and deploy fix.
